description: Defines the 'ai_interface' class for AI behavior in the Wesnoth game, including nested 'info' struct, methods for AI actions, and external dependencies.

classes.name: ai_interface
classes.description: Abstract base class for AI implementations, providing interface for game decision-making and actions.

classes.name: ai_interface::info
classes.description: Holds references to game objects and state needed by AI to make decisions.

methods.name: play_turn
methods.description: Pure virtual function to execute AI turn logic.

methods.name: sync_network
methods.description: Updates networked players with AI actions.

methods.name: attack_enemy
methods.description: Commands AI to attack an enemy unit.

methods.name: move_unit
methods.description: Moves a unit to a specified location.

methods.name: move_unit_partial
methods.description: Moves a unit without ending its movement allowance.

methods.name: calculate_possible_moves
methods.description: Calculates possible move paths for units.

methods.name: recruit
methods.description: Recruits a unit at a location.

methods.name: get_info
methods.description: Returns the 'info' object with game state references.

methods.name: user_interact
methods.description: Allows user interaction during AI processing.
